articles.title: $4.9M Loan for Red Dog Mine Solar Array
articles.summary: The Alaska Energy Authority approved a $4.9 million loan to build an 8.8-MW solar array for Red Dog Mine.

articles.title: Alaska legislative task force hears overwhelming public support for more investment in schools
articles.summary: Testifiers urged support for more funding to address the state's teacher shortage, special education needs and rising costs of energy for transportation and school maintenance.

articles.title: Solar farm planned for Red Dog Mine would be the largest in Alaska
articles.summary: Teck Alaska, which operates the mine, projects Red Dog will spend $40 to $45 million just on energy this year.
